business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Importation of Deep-Frozen Meat Carcasses and Pelagic Fish

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States Treaty Concerning the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investment (in force 1964)
Multilateral DTAAs under Luxembourg tax treaty network (over 80 jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local notary or consular authority in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if from an Apostille Convention jurisdiction) or Consular Legalization (for non-member jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for notarial certification or consular attestation if notarial capacity is not apparent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or notarized translation with apostille if self-certification is not accepted

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or financial institution where shareholder maintains accounts
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if bank signature needs validation; otherwise direct original letter

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of non-disclosure / insolvency or criminal record excerpt for managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial or police authority in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening against EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Sanctions Lists, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and domestic Luxembourg FIU caution lists. Enhanced due diligence on politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates as defined by FATF Recommendations 12 and 22. Mandatory ongoing transaction monitoring and 5-year record retention under CSSF Regulation No. 12-02 and AML/CFT Law. Refusal to incorporate if any positive sanction match unless a Luxembourg Ministry of Finance authorization is obtained for asset-freeze exemptions.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – electronic platform for the Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS): https://www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names may be in any language using Latin characters, but the trade register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) requires a French or German or Luxembourgish transliteration for searchability. The legal form must be indicated as 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or 'SARL'. Names must not be contrary to public order, misleading, or identical/confusingly similar to existing registered names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In case of name rejection, the applicant may file a formal re-examination request with the RCS registration office (Division des personnes morales) within 15 days of notification. If the RCS maintains the refusal, an administrative appeal can be lodged with the Luxembourg Administrative Tribunal (Tribunal administratif) within three months of the re-examination decision. In parallel, the applicant may submit a revised name for preliminary clearance through the LBR's 'name reservation' service. All appeals must be in French or German, with legal representation not mandatory but strongly recommended.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a wholesale importer of deep-frozen meat and seafood requiring an import/export license under veterinary and food-safety regulations, a pure virtual office is not permissible. The SARL must maintain a physical registered office in Luxembourg and actual operational substance, including a licensed cold storage or documented contract with a bonded cold-chain warehouse. Administrative-only virtual offices are permitted only for holding companies or non-licensed trading entities, but not for this ISIC scope with statutory licenses.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 40% within the first 12 months of operation; the Luxembourg veterinary administration (ASTA) and the Food Safety Inspectorate conduct planned and unannounced inspections of importers' premises and cold-chain facilities. Unannounced onsite checks by the RCS or tax authorities may occur in 15% of newly incorporated trading companies. The risk is elevated due to the transshipment of animal products under EU veterinary and customs controls.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (Loi du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), particularly Article 710-1 et seq. governing the Société à Responsabilité Limitée (S.à r.l.), together with the amended Law of 19 December 2002 on the Register of Commerce and Companies and on the RCS accounting and publication requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operating under the Luxembourg Ministry of Justice through the e-Justice portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized deed of incorporation and articles of association (acte constitutif and statuts), filed for registration with the RCS through the LBR e-Justice electronic filing application.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The S.à r.l. requires minimum subscribed capital of EUR 12,000. Cash contributions must be deposited before execution of the deed in a blocked account with a Luxembourg credit institution in the name of the company to be formed; each subscriber must pay up at least 25% of the nominal value of the subscribed cash shares at subscription, and contributions in kind must be fully paid up immediately. The blocked account may be released only upon RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.À R.L. The first Board, acting pursuant to the notarized articles of association, unanimously resolves and records that: (1) the subscriptions to the share capital are accepted, and all contributions have been lawfully made in accordance with Luxembourg law; (2) the registered office of the company is established at [Full Address], Luxembourg City, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg; (3) the Board appoints [Name] as sole manager (gérant) and [Name] as alternate manager, each authorized individually to execute banking instructions and represent the company; (4) the manager is directed and authorized to file the RCS registration dossier, obtain business and food-import permits, and complete all further steps required by Luxembourg law; and (5) each action taken by the manager in connection with this incorporation and licensing process is hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation legal review and corporate name verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of a Luxembourg civil-law notary, with name verification through the Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) and RCS records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a Luxembourg notary to prepare the draft articles of association and coordinate founders. Conduct an availability search and a preliminary verification of the proposed corporate name against the RCS. Obtain landlord consent or title evidence for the intended registered office. Compile beneficial ownership and source-of-funds information for the notary's client due diligence file.
required_dossiers: Passport or national identity card of each shareholder and manager
Proof of residential address and corporate address
Registered-office landlord's written permission or title deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected or reserved by an earlier entity, the notary will present alternative names and the founders must sign a revised name selection before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the blocked share-capital account and capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution (monitored by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier - CSSF).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders or their mandate open a blocked account in the name of the company to be formed, deposit not less than EUR 12,000 of cash subscription proceeds, and obtain a capital-blocking certificate from the bank stating the amount deposited and the account's blocked status until RCS registration. The bank performs customer due diligence and anti-money-laundering verification on all principals before accepting funds.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and proof of legal existence of shareholders
Final expected shareholder list and share subscription schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the origin of funds or beneficial ownership, supply notarially certified identification documents, audited financial statements of corporate shareholders, and a lawful source-of-funds statement; re-submit the account opening file after curing the identified deficiencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the notarized incorporation deed and articles of association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary verifies legal capacity and capital deposit, reads the deed to the parties, and has each founder sign the notarized deed of incorporation and articles. The deed must include the company name, registered office, corporate purpose covering wholesale import and cold-chain distribution of deep-frozen meat and seafood, share capital, shareholder registers, management powers, and statutory legal representations. The managers execute their acceptance of office in the deed or by separate signed instrument.
required_dossiers: Capital-blocking certificate of the Luxembourg bank
Passport copies and official identification of all signatories and managers
Proof of registered office address and landlord consent
Criminal record certificate of each proposed manager or qualified equivalent
Declaration of payment of subscription minima
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies legal defects or missing consents, the notary will issue a correction memorandum, obtain supplementary shareholder consents, and re-date the execution session; no residual defect will be allowed to proceed to RCS filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS filing, registration and publication of the legal notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary lodges the notarized deed with the RCS through the LBR e-Justice filing portal together with the registration request and payment of the filing fee. After the RCS examiner verifies legal conformity, the company is registered and assigned an RCS registration number. The registration entry is published in the electronic legal gazette, Recueil électronique des sociétés (RESA), and an official certificate of registration is issued.
required_dossiers: Notarized original deed of incorporation and articles
Official addresses of principal shareholders and managers
Declaration of beneficial owners under the Luxembourg register requirements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS examiner issues a query or request for rectification, the notary prepares and executes a corrective notarial act (acte rectificatif), and the corrected file is resubmitted through the e-Justice portal within the procedural time limit stated by the RCS.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, customs, social security and food-chain activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); Luxembourg Customs and Excise Administration; Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS); and Administration des services vétérinaires (ASV).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration and bank account release, file the VAT registration declaration with the AEDT, obtain an EORI number from Luxembourg Customs, register as an employer with the CCSS, notify a designated economic substance address, and apply with the ASV for approval as a food business operator under Regulation (EC) No 853/2004 before commencing import or cold-store operations.
required_dossiers: Food business operator registration and cold-store approval application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT or customs registration is queried due to insufficient local substance, provide a full functional management and wage declaration showing the Luxembourg premises, local manager and intended taxable operations; for food-chain approval queries, submit HACCP plan, temperature-monitoring protocols and building plans to the ASV.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy – General Directorate for Crafts and Trades for business establishment licensing, together with the Administration des services vétérinaires (ASV) and the Food Safety Department of the Ministry of Health for approval of the cold-store food establishment under Regulation (EC) No 853/2004.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food business operator establishment approval for cold storage and wholesale distribution of frozen meat and seafood, issued as an approved storage facility under Regulation (EC) No 853/2004, supplemented by the Luxembourg business establishment licence (autorisation d'établissement) under the amended Law of 2 September 2011 regulating access to crafts and independent business.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'Environnement – Ministry for Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Low-impact registration/declaration tier for a refrigerated warehouse and wholesale cold chain; a full EIA report is not required where refrigerant charge is below state thresholds, but an environmental declaration must be filed when the refrigeration installation contains fluorinated greenhouse gases or ammonia above regulatory notification limits.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Regulation (EU) No 517/2014 on fluorinated greenhouse gases; no intentional release of refrigerants; defrosting and floor-cleaning wastewater must meet the municipal sewer discharge limits for suspended solids, biochemical oxygen demand and pH; waste handling of spoiled or rejected frozen products must follow the Luxembourg Law on Waste Management and permit requirements for organic waste disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the CGDIS fire and rescue service, including cold-room escape-door and fire-alarm compliance; structural load clearance by a certified engineer for heavy racking and carcass storage; occupational health and workplace clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) covering low-temperature work, permitted working hours, emergency rescue protocols and worker welfare in cold environments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL); prudential supervision of credit institutions is exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF), and the Ministry of Finance sets exchange-control policy; no separate foreign-exchange inspectorate exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a euro-area member and applies full convertibility under Articles 63–66 TFEU on both capital and current accounts. Profit remittance and dividend distribution require no prior exchange-control approval, but are conditioned on corporate-law solvency tests, audited accounts where statutory thresholds are met, and applicable withholding tax documentation. Payments to sanctioned counterparts or to persons on FATF high-risk lists may be frozen under EU restrictive measures without a convertibility issue.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. There is no statutory foreign-currency surrender, no minimum conversion percentage, and no holding-period restriction on export receipts. All settlements can be received in EUR through SEPA, in EUR by SWIFT, or in any freely convertible currency. Euro-denominated cash deposits of €10,000 or more trigger CSSF AML/CTF reporting, and all transactions are subject to EU sanctions screening.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account & Trade Finance Escrow Sub-Account
Operational Account & Import LC Margin Account
Operational Account & Warehouse Receipt Facility Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a supplementary receiving/payout rail for small-value transactions, but Low as the primary treasury rail. Legal constraints under PSD2 and Luxembourg law of 21 July 2010: any non-EU/offshore digital EMI must be authorized or passport into Luxembourg through the CSSF; unlicensed offshore EMIs cannot issue EU-registered IBANs, cannot access BCL settlement systems, cannot legally operate corporate current accounts for a Luxembourg SARL, and are unacceptable as counterparties for trade finance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical interview is effectively mandatory if the director is non-resident in the EU or in a jurisdiction without FATF-equivalent AML supervision; remote opening is occasionally accepted using CSSF-approved video identification and qualified electronic signatures for EU-resident directors. For a newly formed import SARL, the first director and the signatory of the bank account should attend an in-person commercial meeting at the Luxembourg branch or provide a notarized power of attorney with apostille and a certified passport copy; local corporate agents cannot fully substitute for the UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity or artificial layering in beneficial ownership of the SARL (offshore nominee shareholders or intervening trusts)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full ownership cascade with each UBO under 5th AMLD; notarized deed of incorporation and registered office certificate; sworn declaration of direct and indirect holdings; consolidated annual accounts or source-of-wealth statement for each qualifying shareholder; tax identification numbers and virtual identity signatures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to deep-frozen meat/seafood suppliers in jurisdictions rated high-risk or partially compliant by FATF
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory import licence, veterinary border-inspection certificate, freezing chain temperature logs, bill of lading and CMR, custom-clearance proof from Luxembourg Customs, pro-forma invoice and commercial contract, supplier UBO and corporate registry extract, sanctions screening output, LC draft or bank payment proof.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual transaction velocity or high invoice amounts relative to declared capital during the first 12 months
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercially reasoned 12-month cash-flow forecast; signed supply agreements and volume forecasts; provisional VAT return and EORI number; warehouse lease and cold-chain operator invoices; inventory financing facility term sheet; auditor or fiduciary accountant confirmation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EU resident director or manager without demonstrable economic nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport copy with apostille, police clearance certificate from country of residence, EU residence or travel-history evidence, signed manager mandate or employment agreement, authorisation letter countersigned by all UBOs, original or certified copy of board resolution appointing the director, notarised bank references.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media/sanctions hits or matches in politically exposed persons (PEP) databases
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Positive identification documentation, explanation letter in writing, full source-of-funds and source-of-wealth file for each PEP, adverse media disproving reports, independent legal opinion from Luxembourg counsel, bank-approved compliance due-diligence questionnaire.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The shareholder injects equity via SWIFT MT103/MT202 using purpose code S010 (capital subscription) and must cite the notary's escrow account reference and the SARL's VAT/EORI identifiers. The receiving Luxembourg credit institution will treat the transfer as a capital inflow subject to standard AML due diligence; a copy of the notarised incorporation deed and a board resolution approving the capital call must accompany settlement. There is no exchange-control recognition required, but the bank must verify the remitter's authority and the final UBO layer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For procurement of frozen beef and seafood, the standard clearing rails are: (1) irrevocable documentary letter of credit issued by the Luxembourg relationship bank via SWIFT MT700, with a confirming bank in the exporter's jurisdiction and reimbursement through MT103/MT202; (2) direct SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer against a pro-forma invoice and sanitary certificate; (3) SEPA credit transfer (SCT/SDD) for EU counterparties; and (4) domiciliated direct debit to the Luxembourg Customs and Excise Administration for the payment of import duties and VAT. All documents must include the ISIC 4632 commercial code and customs procedure code 40 or equivalent.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable EUR/NOK, EUR/SEK, EUR/GBP, EUR/USD, EUR/AUD, EUR/NZD and EUR/JPY forwards traded with a BCL-licensed credit institution against real commercial exposure
Cross-currency swaps matching both principal and interest on tradefinance facilities in a non-EUR currency
Vanilla FX options or option collars for purchase contracts denominated in USD at a perimeter (CAD/GBP) where the hedge is documented against the frozen meat and seafood import portfolio

AUD/CAD or other non-deliverable contracts prohibited: all currencies are deliverable in Luxembourg, so NDFs and non-deliverable swaps are considered speculative and generally disallowed unless a residual inconvertibility is demonstrated by the clearing bank

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels) in small/micro format
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must approve annual accounts within 6 months after the financial year-end; certified copy must be filed within 1 month after approval. For a calendar-year SARL, the maximum filing deadline is 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the company to a €10-per-day late fee after formal notification, potential director fines, and, after repeated non-compliance, a court-ordered administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership register (RBE) declaration and update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial UBO declaration within 1 month of incorporation; every change in direct or indirect beneficial ownership, including share transfers, must be filed within 1 month of the event. Annual confirmation is performed internally at the AGM/accounts-approval date, but no separate statutory annual deadline applies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or update UBO information is a criminal offence punishable by fines ranging from €125 to €250,000 per breach; the conviction may be published on the RBE and the directors may be subject to disqualification measures under the Law of 13 January 2019.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Luxembourg SARL is subject to a mandatory independent statutory audit if, for two consecutive financial years, it exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds: balance sheet total over €4.4 million, net turnover over €8.8 million, and average number of employees over 50.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP for statutory annual accounts of unlisted SARL entities, based on the Law of 18 December 2015 and the Law of 19 December 2019 on bookkeeping and annual accounts; IFRS as endorsed by the EU is permitted only for consolidated statements or listed undertakings.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Luxembourg imposes no separate annual UBO confirmation return; the RBE register must be continuously accurate and any change in shareholding or beneficial ownership must be filed within one month. At least once annually, the registered agent should reconcile the RBE filing against the members' register and AGM minutes and correct any outdated entries immediately.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 17% Corporate Income Tax (IRC) for FY 2024; plus 7% solidarity surcharge on the IRC (1.19%) and communal business tax (impôt commercial communal) at the Luxembourg City rate of 6.75%, producing an aggregate headline burden of 24.94% for a Luxembourg City SARL.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Participation exemption: 100% exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains on shareholdings of at least 10% or an acquisition cost of at least EUR 1.2 million held for at least 12 months. IP box: 80% exemption of net qualifying IP income, producing an effective rate of approximately 5%. Investment tax credit for eligible tangible assets available on a scaled basis.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no time limit); annual set-off capped at 70% of taxable income in excess of EUR 15,000; no carryback.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modèle 100 - Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités (Form 100); mandatory electronic filing through the ACD e-filing module (eCDF) accessible via MyGuichet.lu; annexes include balance sheet and profit/loss schedules, Form 101 depreciation schedule, and the related-party transaction disclosure schedule.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 31 December of the calendar year following the fiscal year-end (e.g., FY 2024 return due 31 December 2025); taxpayers represented by an approved tax adviser receive an automatic extension; quarterly advance payments fall due on 10 March, 10 June, 10 September and 10 December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the SARL, RCS registration number, legal form (société à responsabilité limitée), registered office address and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Luxembourg branch address and local tax representative; attach a certified copy of the power of attorney where filing is delegated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting year start and end dates; first tax period or short-period notification.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the branch's annual accounts; if newly registered, align with the Luxembourg statutory accounting year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that annual accounts were filed with the Luxembourg Business Registers and audited where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies with a Luxembourg permanent establishment (PE) must file branch accounts; attach a reconciliation of books to the tax return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Net turnover and gross margin
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate wholesale turnover from deep-frozen meat and seafood imports and the gross trading margin.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare only Luxembourg-sourced sales; export sales outside Luxembourg are excluded unless attributable to the Luxembourg PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees, gross wages and social security contributions recorded in the profit and loss account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the branch has no employees, enter zero and describe outsourced logistics in the appendices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 6 - Result before tax (résultat avant impôt)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Commercial net profit per statutory accounts before corporate income tax, solidarity surcharge and communal business tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a PE, allocate profits under the OECD Authorized OECD Approach; attach a profit attribution memorandum.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 - Non-deductible additions and income deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add back non-deductibles (fines, gifts, 50% of directors' fees, excessive interest) and deduct exempt income (dividends under the participation exemption, 80% of qualifying IP income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Gift and director fee limitations apply equally; withhold 15% on any directors' fees paid to non-resident directors unless treaty-reduced.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of prior-year tax losses against current profit; attach the loss history schedule and evidence of continuity of activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of a foreign head office cannot be attributed to the Luxembourg PE unless reflected in the PE accounts under Luxembourg GAAP.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 9 - Taxable base and tax computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income after adjustments; computation of IRC at 17%, solidarity surcharge and communal business tax at the applicable commune rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Communal business tax applies to PEs located in Luxembourg; indicate the commune of the PE's place of effective installation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of aggregate cross-border transactions with related parties (types, counterparties, pricing method, amounts), including management fees, commissions, rebates and cold-chain storage charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a transfer pricing documentation index demonstrating the arm's length nature of the import markups; the ACD may issue a 30-day production order.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 10% majoration on the tax payable (minimum EUR 25); late-payment interest of 0.3% per month (3.6% per annum); failure to file within 30 days of a formal notice triggers ex officio assessment and an additional surcharge; willful non-filing is punishable by a criminal fine of up to EUR 25,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% standard domestic rate on dividends paid by a Luxembourg SARL to non-resident shareholders; 0% for qualifying EU parent companies under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive; treaty rates are commonly 5% for shareholdings of at least 10% and 15% otherwise.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain a Luxembourg certificate of fiscal residence (Formulaire 210/22) or the equivalent foreign Tax Residence Certificate and a beneficial ownership declaration; file a 'demande de dispense de retenue à la source' with the ACD Bureau d'imposition via eCDF before the dividend payment to obtain a 0% or 5% withholding authorization; if WHT was deducted, file a refund claim with the ACD within the applicable limitation period (generally five years), attaching the TRC, shareholding certificate, and an excerpt of the share register; treaty benefits may be denied under the Principal Purpose Test of the MLI.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% domestic withholding tax and 0% under all Luxembourg tax treaties (IP licence fees paid by the SARL to non-resident licensors are paid gross). Interest on arm's-length debt: 0% domestic withholding tax and 0% under treaties. Exception: interest on profit-participating loans (jouissance) is treated as dividend-equivalent income and attracts the 15% withholding tax subject to treaty reduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory EUR threshold for Local File or Master File in Luxembourg domestic law; OECD-aligned TP documentation under Article 56 LIR and Circular LIR n° 56/1 must be produced within 30 days of an ACD request. Country-by-Country Reporting is mandatory for MNE groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million. The Form 100 e-filing includes a cross-border related-party transaction disclosure schedule applicable where aggregate related-party flows exceed EUR 100,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations; substance requirements derive from tax residence (Article 159 LIR: registered seat plus central administration or effective management), the GAAR codified under ATAD, Luxembourg's EU Code of Conduct Group commitments, and the MLI Principal Purpose Test. For a meat-importing SARL, the ACD expects local premises, operational management decisions, cold-chain or logistics capability, and payroll substance to support treaty access and the participation exemption; letterbox distribution companies are re-characterized.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Fraudulent Income Tax Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying import books, concealing cash turnover, under-invoicing frozen beef or seafood sales, fabricating supplier invoices, or repeatedly failing to declare Luxembourg-source profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative majoration of 10% of the evaded tax plus late-payment interest; additional fine of up to 100% of evaded tax; criminal sanctions of imprisonment from 8 days to 5 years and/or fines up to EUR 25,000 under the Luxembourg General Tax Code; confiscation of proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and de facto managers who sign false returns face joint civil liability for evaded tax, personal criminal fines, asset seizure, travel bans, and disqualification from managing Luxembourg companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The SARL has no employees, no premises, no board minutes, or no commercial decision-making in Luxembourg, with management outsourced to shell service providers and used as a conduit for import margins into a tax-haven parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax residence certificate, revocation of participation exemption, GAAR re-allocation of profits, loss of treaty benefits under the MLI Principal Purpose Test, reassessment with 10% surcharge and 0.3% monthly interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominated directors of substance-less companies become personally liable for resulting tax liabilities if they knowingly signed declarations of conformity; regulatory removal by the Luxembourg Business Registers and potential criminal prosecution for aiding abusive arrangements.
